name: Pricing Page — displays pricing tiers with plan details

planSteps.description: The page displays a heading containing 'الأسعار' or 'الباقات' or 'Pricing'
At least 2 pricing cards or plan sections are visible on the page
Each pricing card shows a price value (a number) and a currency indicator (ر.س or SAR or $)
At least one card has a CTA button with text like 'ابدأ' or 'اشترك' or 'اختر' or 'جرب'
